title: Genesis 4:8 — Cain rises up against Abel and kills him
summary: Genesis 4:8 in English: Cain talked with Abel his brother, and when they were in the field Cain rose up against Abel and killed him. Cain is highlighted in green and Abel in blue.

text.text: 8 And Cain talked with Abel his brother; and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
